test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which of the following forts of Rajasthan is famous for the historic event known as Dhai Sako?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaisalmer Fort**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jaisalmer Fort

 
 
• Jaisalmer Fort is famous for "Dhai Saka" (Two and a Half Sakas).
 
• The first Saka of Jaisalmer Fort occurred during Alauddin Khilji's invasion (1296-1316 AD).
 
• The second Saka occurred during Firoz Shah Tughlaq's invasion (1351-1388 AD), when Rawal Duda, Trilokasi, and other Bhati heroes were martyred in battle.
 
• The third Saka is known as "Ardhasaka" ("Half Saka") because the warriors were martyred in battle, but no Jauhar (mass self-immolation) took place.
 
• Rawal Lunakaran was martyred in 1550 AD in a battle with Amir Ali.
 
• However, since the Bhatis emerged victorious, the women did not perform Jauhar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gagron Fort

 
 
• In 1423 AD, Sultan Hoshangshah of Mandu attacked Gagron Fort, and the ruler of that time, Achaldas Khinchi, was martyred.
 
• The women performed Jauhar. This is known as the first Saka of Gagron.
 
• In 1444 AD, Sultan Mahmud Khilji I of Malwa captured the fort.
 
• At that time, the women of the fort performed Jauhar, which became known as the second Saka of Gagron.
 
 
 
• Ranthambore Fort
 
 
• In 1301 AD, due to the betrayal of Hammir's ministers, Alauddin Khilji succeeded in capturing Ranthambore Fort.
 
• During this time, Hammir's wife Rangdevi and daughter Deval De led the women in performing Jauhar, which is known as the first Saka of Ranthambore.
 
 
 
• **Chittorgarh Fort**
 
 
• In the eighth century, Bappa Rawal, the founder of the Guhilot dynasty, seized the fort from the last Maurya ruler, Manamori.
 
• First Saka - In 1303 AD, during the time of Alauddin Khilji, associated with the Jauhar of Padmini and the exceptional valor of Gora and Badal.
 
• Second Saka - In 1534 AD, the Jauhar of Rani Karnavati, wife of Rana Sanga, during the time of Sultan Bahadur Shah of Gujarat.
 
• Third Saka - In 1568 AD, the Jauhar of the wives of Jaimal and Fatta and the tales of their courageous sacrifice during the attack of Akbar.
 
• These are known as the three Sakas of Chittorgarh.
